content.short: Discover Ekubo, a highly optimized DeFi Dapps protocol focusing on decentralized exchanges (dexs) to drive mass adoption in Web3.
content.description: Powerful AMM on Starknet providing high capital efficiency. Operating at the forefront of the DeFi Dapps sector, Ekubo redefines how users interact with decentralized exchanges (dexs). The protocol leverages the advanced capabilities of Starknet to provide a seamless, non-custodial experience that guarantees user sovereignty. Its architecture is explicitly built for scale, accommodating high throughput and complex decentralized operations. With a strong commitment to open-source principles, Ekubo stands out as a crucial utility in the modern Web3 tech stack.
